text_block_list.text:
Just as Ines Fujin and I complete the<n>day's
training regimen...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We did great out there! Feels like our<n>training
session went by in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I've got a delivery job lined<n>up after this. I
think I might use it to<n>get some solo training in.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I usually use my bike when I'm<n>making
deliveries, but this time I'll<n>use my legs!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Being able to sweat it out on my shift<n>makes
delivering the perfect job for<n>training!

Ines Fujin might be raring to go, but<n>she could very
well overexert herself<n>if she delivers everything on
foot...
choice_data_list: You'll strain yourself, so ride your bike instead.

text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin makes her deliveries with<n>all the vigor
she can muster, building<n>up her strength in the
process.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I guess if I end up exhausting<n>myself, I
won't be in any state to do<n>my regular training...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Got it! If that's what you think's best,<n>I'll go on my
bike!

Earnestly heeding my request, Ines<n>Fujin takes
care not to overwork<n>herself.
